_about: Every model this lab depends on, pinned. Re-embedding is the expensive operation, so a changed embedding revision means the Chroma index must be rebuilt. HF models load from the default Hugging Face cache; set HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 to guarantee nothing is re-fetched.

environment.platform: macOS 26.2, Apple M5 (arm64), torch MPS backend

models.purpose: Dense embeddings for chunks and queries (vector half of hybrid search)
models.notes: Normalize embeddings (normalize_embeddings=True) and use cosine distance in Chroma. BGE recommends the query prefix 'Represent this sentence for searching relevant passages: ' for short queries.

models.purpose: Cross-encoder reranking of the fused (BM25 + vector) candidate set
models.notes: CrossEncoder.predict() returns sigmoid scores in 0-1 for this single-label model; only the ordering matters.

models.purpose: Page layout analysis: finds text blocks, headings, tables, pictures and their reading order
models.notes: Docling 2.130.0 requests revision 'main'; this is the commit 'main' resolved to on the recorded date. To freeze it, pass this hash via LayoutOptions(model_spec=...) or run offline.

models.purpose: Table structure recognition (rows, columns, cells) for detected tables, including gridless ones
OCR for the image-only PDFs inside Docling
models.notes: Chosen engine: Docling's auto OCR selects it first on macOS. No download, runs on the Apple Neural Engine, fastest and cleanest output in smoke tests. Caveat: the underlying Vision model is versioned with macOS (26.2 here), not by pip, so it is pinned only as tightly as the OS.

models.purpose: Portable OCR fallback for non-macOS machines (Docling RapidOcrOptions(backend='onnxruntime'))
models.model: RapidOCR PP-OCRv6 det/rec small + ch_ppocr_mobile_v2.0 cls (ONNX)

models.purpose: Named-entity recognition (PERSON, LOCATION, DATE_TIME) behind Presidio's analyzer
Captions figures/charts that Docling detects as picture elements (e.g. the auto-loan bar chart)
models.notes: API-hosted, nothing downloaded. Pinned by model ID; requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. Server-side refusal fallbacks are enabled (beta server-side-fallback-2026-07-01, fallbacks='default'), so each cached caption records the model that actually served it. Captions are cached by (image hash, model ID, prompt version), so the eval never calls the API.
